# Claude Code 2.1.327 model picker

Captured on macOS on 2026-11-17 using private e2e configuration and no model
turns. Screens retain only the native dialog and remove trailing blank cells.

`collapsed`, `more-selected`, and `expanded` show the primary catalog and its
selectable `More models` disclosure. `compact-*` were captured at 100×24 with
Opus 4.6 current. The standalone hidden-item counts include the disclosure;
numbered model ordinals exclude it. A current legacy model appears in the
primary group and is omitted from its old legacy position.

Expanding and cancelling preserved the current model and effort. Number keys
and Enter on model rows were never used: Claude persists those selections.
